Pikeman.description: Armed with a sturdy pike, they form the backbone of Erathia's armies, reliable in defense and ideal for holding battle lines.

Halberdier.description: Veteran soldiers wielding deadly halberds, Halberdiers hit harder than Pikemen and hold the front line with grim determination.

Archer.description: Nimble crossbowmen who rain down bolts from a distance, Archers keep enemy units at bay before they close in.

Marksman.description: Elite castle sharpshooters whose rapid double shot devastates advancing foes before they ever reach the front line.

Griffin.description: Majestic half-eagle, half-lion warriors, Griffins soar above the battlefield to strike with powerful talons.

RoyalGriffin.description: Royal Griffins retaliate an unlimited number of times per round, making them exceptionally dangerous as bodyguards.

Swordsman.description: Disciplined veterans of Erathia's infantry, Swordsmen combine solid offense and defense to anchor any battle line.

Crusader.description: Holy warriors in blessed armor who strike twice per turn and are immune to curses and dark magic.

Monk.description: Devout clerics who channel divine energy into ranged blasts, Monks provide flexible fire support for Castle armies.

Zealot.description: Fanatical holy warriors of supreme faith who combine ranged fire with remarkable resilience against all forms of magic.

Cavalier.description: Mounted knights charging at full tilt — Cavaliers gain bonus damage proportional to the distance they travel in a turn.

Champion.description: The pinnacle of Castle cavalry; Champions charge with even greater devastating force than the Cavalier.

Angel.description: Radiant celestial warriors whose divine presence strikes fear into undead enemies and inspires all allied forces.

Archangel.description: Beings of pure light and good, Archangels strike with deadly precision and can resurrect fallen allies once per battle.

Imp.description: The weakest of Hell's foot soldiers, Imps are nonetheless numerous and can drain enemy mana with their pernicious touch.

Familiar.description: Upgraded Imps with greater speed and slightly better combat prowess; Familiars drain mana to bolster Inferno spellcasters.

Gog.description: Squat Inferno creatures who hurl fireballs from the depths of Hell, providing reliable ranged support for Inferno armies.

Magog.description: Enhanced Gogs that lob explosive fireballs damaging both a target and adjacent hexes, spreading chaos through enemy ranks.

HellHound.description: Swift infernal beasts that ignore enemy retaliation when attacking — perfect for harassing and flanking vulnerable targets.

Cerberus.description: Three-headed guardians of Hell that attack all adjacent enemies simultaneously and never provoke retaliation.

Demon.description: Standard Inferno foot soldiers who fight with savage ferocity and can summon additional Demons from the bodies of the slain.

HornedDemon.description: Superior Demons with wickedly sharp horns and improved defenses who charge with alarming speed for such heavy warriors.

PitFiend.description: Hulking demonic commanders who channel pure hatred into every swing, among the most formidable mid-tier fighters in Erathia.

PitLord.description: Lords of the abyss who gate new Demons in from the underworld, turning every enemy death into a strategic resource.

Efreet.description: Fire spirits of ancient power surrounded by magical flames that incinerate any enemy who dares to strike them.

EfreetSultan.description: The most powerful fire spirits in the demon hierarchy — Efreet Sultans move at blinding speed and are nearly immune to fire.

Devil.description: Terrifying champions of Hell who teleport across the battlefield and reduce enemy luck to zero, inspiring dread in all who face them.

ArchDevil.description: Supreme lords of the Inferno whose devastating strikes and demoralizing aura make them among the most feared creatures in existence.

Skeleton.description: The most basic undead warriors, Skeletons are resurrected foot soldiers that serve the Necromancer with endless obedience.

SkeletonWarrior.description: Skeletons outfitted with reinforced armor and better weapons — noticeably more resilient than their basic counterparts.

WalkingDead.description: Freshly animated corpses still capable of basic movement — slow but immune to morale penalties and fear.

Zombie.description: Rotting undead with surprising resilience — Zombies inflict a slowing disease curse on any unit they manage to strike.

Wight.description: Spectral undead warriors that drain the very life force of their enemies, permanently reducing enemy unit counts with each hit.

Wraith.description: Upgraded Wights whose harrowing life drain permanently reduces the maximum health of any enemy unit they wound.

Vampire.description: Dark lords of the undead who feast on enemy blood — Vampires restore hit points equal to the damage they deal.

VampireLord.description: Elite Vampires who rise again after being slain, regenerating health each round and never provoking retaliation.

Lich.description: Powerful undead sorcerers who bombard enemies with clouds of death magic, damaging both targets and adjacent hexes.

PowerLich.description: Arcane masters of necromantic energy — Power Liches unleash devastating death clouds that decimate tightly-packed ranks.

BlackKnight.description: Nightmarish horsemen wreathed in shadow who curse their victims so they can never strike back at full strength.

DreadKnight.description: The most terrifying cavalry of the Necropolis — Dread Knights have a chance to inflict double damage on each attack.

BoneDragon.description: Skeletal remnants of once-mighty dragons — slower than their living kin but still devastating in melee combat.

GhostDragon.description: Ancient spectral dragons that can age entire enemy units in a single breath, reducing them to decrepitude and certain death.
